name: facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/lo.create_local_tensorfs_model: create a LocalTensorfs model with fov, n_init_frames, n_overlap, WH, and learning rate parameters for self-calibrating local tensor factorization
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/lo.append_frame_to_local_tensorfs: append a new camera frame with pose parameters and optimizers to the LocalTensorfs model for incremental training
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/lo.append_rf_to_local_tensorfs: append a new radiance field with blending weights to the LocalTensorfs model for multi-view scene reconstruction
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/lo.optimize_poses_and_rf: run optimizer_step on the LocalTensorfs model to optimize camera poses, exposure, and radiance field parameters with loss backward pass
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/lo.forward_render_rays: render rays through the LocalTensorfs model to get RGB colors, depth maps, and ray directions for given ray and view IDs

facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/op.run_config_parser_with_defaults: run the config_parser function to parse default arguments for local TensoRF training

facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/op.build_training_config: build a configuration with custom learning rate and voxel settings for TensorVMSplit model training
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/op.build_rendering_config: build a configuration with render_only mode enabled to render from a saved checkpoint file
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/op.review_config_parser_arguments: review the config_parser function to understand all available training and rendering arguments

facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/re.render_rgb_depth_frames: render RGB and depth map frames from a Local TensoRF model using camera poses and ray IDs
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/re.render_test_with_metrics: render test frames and compute MSE and SSIM metrics against ground truth RGB images
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/re.render_optical_flow_comparison: render forward and backward optical flow comparisons between predicted and ground truth flow fields
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/re.render_depth_error_comparison: render depth error comparison visualizations between predicted and ground truth inverse depth maps
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/re.render_save_video_frames: render frames and save RGB, depth, and camera pose videos as MP4 files to disk

facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/tr.run_reconstruction: run the local TensoRF reconstruction pipeline with pose optimization and progressive refinement
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/tr.render_test_frames: render test frames from a trained checkpoint using the render_test function
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/tr.render_smooth_path: render a smooth spline camera path from poses using the render_frames function
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/tr.save_transforms_json: save camera poses and intrinsics to a transforms.json file using save_transforms
facebookresearch_localrf/localTensoRF/tr.run_cli_entry: run the train.py CLI entry point to start reconstruction or rendering via config_parser
